d: Euro Motors set out to position itself as the leader in the automotive industry in the Kingdom of Bahrain and has since come a long way. From a modest start with only BMW, the dealership has managed to acquire premium brands such as MINI, Land Rover, Rolls-Royce, Ferrari and Maserati under its impressive banner. In doing so, it has preserved each identity with the utmost integrity and dedication. Euro Motors does not compromise on presentation, quality, technical service and customer care. Fully committed to the principle of offering the utmost to our customers, the drive to improve profitability is always conditioned to match promise with performance because every Euro Motors customer is valued. Job Overview

Euro Motors is seeking a highly skilled and meticulous Technician to join our team. This role requires a high level of technical expertise and the ability to navigate BMW’s cutting-edge performance engineering.
q: Proven experience working as an Automotive Technician or in a similar role.
A relevant vocational qualification or certification in automotive technology or mechanics.
In-depth knowledge of various vehicle systems, including electrical, engine, and transmission.
Proficiency in using a wide range of diagnostic tools and workshop equipment.
Excellent problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
r: Repair/ replacement of broken/ worn out parts.
Verification of vehicle functions and its subsystems.
Provides information to the supervisor about preapproval for additional repair.
Notifies the service advisor and service assistant immediately of work interruptions as a result of additionally required work, complications, missing parts or missed deadlines.
Uses checklists/ repair instructions, tools and test equipment adhered to current BMW guidelines.
Handles tools, special tools work clothing etc. properly.
Hands over dismantled, replacement or warranty parts to warranty department cleaned and labelled.
Disposes waste according to local legislated guidelines.
Observes accident prevention guidelines and reporting incidents to his or her supervisor.
